meta.home.title: bb-system — coaching, tracked
banner.beta: bb-system is in beta. Testing is by invitation.
home.hero.line: A coach and the person they coach, sharing training, diet, check-ins and progress in one tracked conversation.
home.student.title: For the student
home.student.p1: Today's training, diet and supplements, exactly as the coach wrote them.
home.student.p2: Log workouts with sets and loads, and the meals you actually ate.
home.student.p3: Send a daily check-in with photos, including what went wrong.
home.student.p4: Chat with your coach in one place.
home.coach.title: For the coach
home.coach.p1: Your assigned students and where each one stands.
home.coach.p2: Review check-ins and reply; new, seen and replied are always clear.
home.coach.p3: Protocols for diet, training and phytotherapy, published to the student's app.
home.coach.p4: The same chat, on your side.
home.progress.title: Progress stays tracked
home.progress.p1: Evolution over time: adherence, loads, measurements and health readings in one view.
home.progress.p2: Every check-in, reply and message is kept, so nothing gets lost in loose chats.
home.progress.p3: Offline-safe: what you type is saved on the device and sent when the connection returns.
home.beta.title: Join the beta
home.beta.p1: bb-system is under development and in alpha/beta testing. The iOS apps, BB Student and BB Coach, are distributed through TestFlight by invitation. An Android app for students is in testing as well.
home.beta.p2: Expect rough edges: screens change between builds, and the beta backend may be reset. Testers are told by e-mail before that happens.
home.beta.p3: To get an invitation, send an e-mail with the subject "bb-system beta" and say whether you are a coach or a student.
home.about.title: Who is behind it
home.about.p1: bb-system is built by ACF Labs. Questions, bug reports and privacy requests go to amadeu01@gmail.com.
meta.home.description: bb-system connects a coach and the person they coach: training, diet, check-ins and progress in one tracked conversation. In beta.
meta.privacy.title: Privacy policy — bb-system
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what bb-system collects, why, who processes it on our behalf, and what you can ask us to do with it. It is written in plain language; if something is unclear, write to us.
privacy.who.title: 1. Who we are
privacy.who.p1: bb-system is built and operated by ACF Labs. For anything in this policy, contact amadeu01@gmail.com.
privacy.scope.title: 2. What this policy covers
privacy.scope.p1: It covers the BB Student and BB Coach apps on iOS and Android, the bb-system web console used by coaches and staff, and this website.
privacy.scope.p2: This website collects nothing and sets no cookies. The only thing it stores in your browser is the language you picked, so the site opens in that language next time. The fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, so your browser sends Google the usual request details (IP address and browser type) to fetch them.
privacy.data.title: 3. Data we collect
privacy.data.p1: We collect only what the coaching relationship needs. By category:
privacy.data.account: Account: your name, e-mail address or username, phone number if you use it to sign in, your password (stored only as a hash), and your role (student, coach or staff).
privacy.data.coaching: Coaching content: the protocols a coach writes for you, covering diet, foods and portions, training plans and supplement instructions.
privacy.data.records: What the student records: saved workouts with exercises, sets, loads and duration; exercise ticks; meals; and the adherence numbers derived from them.
privacy.data.checkins: Check-ins: the text and answers you submit and the photos you attach.
privacy.data.messages: Messages: the chat between a coach and a student.
privacy.data.health: Health data, only if you allow it: steps, active calories, exercise minutes, resting heart rate and sleep, read from Apple Health (HealthKit) on iOS or from Health Connect on Android. We use it to show your evolution and to share it with your coach. We only read; we never write to Apple Health or Health Connect. It is never used for advertising, never sold, and never shared beyond the processors listed below, who store it for us. You can revoke access at any time in Apple Health or Health Connect, and the app keeps working without it.
privacy.data.technical: Technical: crash reports and performance traces (device model, OS version, app version, error details); server logs with IP address and request metadata; and an audit log of who did what in the system, under which role.
privacy.use.title: 4. How we use it
privacy.use.p1: To run the coaching relationship between you and your coach; to show progress over time; to keep the service working and secure; and to send invite codes by e-mail when an account is created.
privacy.use.p2: We do not show advertising, we do not build profiles for third parties, and we do not sell data.
privacy.processors.title: 5. Who processes it for us
privacy.processors.p1: These companies handle data on our behalf. Each receives only what its job needs.
privacy.processors.railway: Railway: hosts the API, the PostgreSQL database and the Redis session store.
privacy.processors.resend: Resend: sends transactional e-mails such as invite codes.
privacy.processors.datadog: Datadog: receives performance traces and server logs.
privacy.processors.sentry: Sentry: receives crash and error reports from the apps and the server.
privacy.access.title: 6. Who can see it
privacy.access.p1: A student's data is visible to the coach or coaches assigned to that student, and to ACF Labs staff with operational access. Staff actions are recorded in the audit log.
privacy.retention.title: 7. Retention
privacy.retention.p1: We keep your data while your account exists. After a deletion request, we delete or anonymise it, except what the law requires us to keep or what is needed to resolve a dispute.
privacy.retention.p2: Crash reports, traces and logs expire on the retention schedules of the processors above.
privacy.rights.title: 8. Your rights
privacy.rights.p1: You can ask to see the data we hold about you, correct it, receive a copy, or have it deleted. Send the request by e-mail to amadeu01@gmail.com from the address on your account, or include your username. We answer within 30 days.
privacy.rights.p2: If you are in Brazil, these are your rights under the LGPD. If you are in the European Union, they are your rights under the GDPR. Wherever you are, we honour them the same way.
privacy.children.title: 9. Children
privacy.children.p1: bb-system is not meant for people under 18 unless a parent or guardian has agreed to it through the coach.
privacy.security.title: 10. Security
privacy.security.p1: All traffic is encrypted in transit. Passwords are stored as hashes. Sessions use short-lived tokens that can be revoked. Staff with global access sign in with a second step from an authenticator app.
privacy.changes.title: 11. Changes
privacy.changes.p1: When this policy changes we update the date at the top. If a change matters to you, we describe it here and tell testers by e-mail.
meta.privacy.description: What bb-system collects, why, who processes it, and how to request access or deletion.
meta.support.title: Support — bb-system
support.title: Support
support.intro: bb-system is in beta, so support is by e-mail and answered by the people building it. Write to amadeu01@gmail.com.
support.help.title: Get help
support.help.p1: Send an e-mail and tell us which app you use (BB Student, BB Coach or the web console), your device and system version, and what happened. If you can, say what you expected instead.
support.bug.title: Report a bug in the beta
support.bug.p1: Bug reports are the most useful thing a tester can send. Include the steps you took, what you saw, and a screenshot or screen recording if you have one. TestFlight's built-in screenshot feedback reaches us too.
support.bug.p2: If the app lost something you typed, tell us when it happened. The app keeps unsent items in an outbox on your device and retries them, so include whether the outbox showed them as waiting or failed.
support.delete.title: Delete your account
support.delete.p1: Send an e-mail from the address on your account, or include your username, with the subject "Delete my account". We confirm by replying, then delete the account within 30 days.
support.delete.p2: What is deleted: your account, your check-ins and photos, your messages, your saved workouts and meals, and any health readings shared from Apple Health or Health Connect. Your coach keeps nothing personal about you; anonymised numbers may remain in their adherence statistics.
support.delete.p3: Crash reports and server logs expire on their own schedule, as described in the privacy policy.
support.delete.link: Read how long we keep data
support.export.title: Request your data
support.export.p1: Send an e-mail from the address on your account, or include your username, with the subject "Export my data". We reply within 30 days with a copy of what we hold about you in a readable format.
support.status.title: Service status
support.status.p1: The beta backend may be reset or have downtime while we work on it. Testers are warned by e-mail before a reset. If the app cannot reach the server, what you typed stays on your device and is sent when the connection returns.
meta.support.description: How to get help with bb-system, report a beta bug, delete your account or request your data.
meta.terms.title: Beta terms — bb-system
terms.title: Beta terms
terms.intro: These terms apply while you test bb-system during its beta. They are short on purpose. By using the apps you agree to them.
terms.asis.title: 1. The service is provided as-is
terms.asis.p1: bb-system is under development. Features may change, break or disappear between builds. We give no guarantee of availability or of fitness for a particular purpose during the beta.
terms.data.title: 2. Data may be reset
terms.data.p1: The beta backend may be reset, which erases accounts and content. We warn testers by e-mail before a reset. Keep your own copy of anything you cannot afford to lose.
terms.invites.title: 3. Invitations
terms.invites.p1: Access is by invitation and may be revoked at any time, for example when a test phase ends. You may not share your invitation or your account with someone else.
terms.medical.title: 4. Not medical advice
terms.medical.p1: bb-system is a tool for a coach and the person they coach. Training, diet and supplement protocols come from your coach, not from us. Nothing in the apps is medical advice. Talk to a doctor before following a protocol if you have a health condition.
terms.use.title: 5. Acceptable use
terms.use.p1: Do not upload content about other people without their permission, do not abuse other users, and do not try to access data that is not yours. Coaches must only use student data to coach that student.
terms.law.title: 6. Governing law
terms.law.p1: These terms are governed by the laws of Brazil.
terms.contact.title: 7. Contact
terms.contact.p1: Questions about these terms go to ACF Labs at amadeu01@gmail.com. Our privacy policy explains how we handle your data.
meta.terms.description: Terms for testing bb-system during its beta.
